_note: TAXO-MATCH-FIX-1108: match rules for vera/chunk_topics.py (chunk-to-subject assignment; used by the Corpus Description page and the owner-run taxonomy induction). A chunk matches a registry entry only if (1) its BM25 score over NON-GENERIC terms reaches the acceptance value (micro_topic.count_min_score.anchor_bm25.scholarly), (2) it shares at least min_distinct_terms distinct non-generic terms with the winning entry's anchor text, and (3) its score is at least min_lead_ratio times the best score of any entry in a different subject area (domain). A document is assigned only when at least min_vote_share of its sampled chunks (and at least subject_areas.min_chunk_votes chunks) voted for the winning key. Generic terms = stopwords + generic_scholarly_terms (academic boilerplate, general statistics and general nouns that appear in every discipline); they never count toward a match. Tokens shorter than min_token_len or made only of digits are generic too.
_calibration_note: PROVISIONAL, 2026-11-08 (TAXO-MATCH-FIX-1108; the implementer had NO database read). Measured only on synthetic text: the review probe (scratch/TAXO-MATCH-REVIEW-1108/probe.py) plus the fixtures in tests/test_taxo_match_fix_1108.py, run against the 10-entry seed registry (same 5 domains as live). Spread seen (work/TAXO-MATCH-FIX-1108/probe_evidence.txt): with the old rule 5 of 5 off-topic scholarly paragraphs matched at BM25 4.7-7.6, each on 2-4 shared anchor terms, all generic (data, uncertainty, results, sample...); with these lists the 5 review paragraphs and 4 held-out off-topic paragraphs keep 0-1 non-generic shared term and none match, while the 10 on-topic fixtures keep 8 or more non-generic shared terms (BM25 15.9-41.2) and lead the other-domain runner-up by at least 4x (runner-up 0.0-6.2). Why these values: min_distinct_terms 2 = the smallest value that rejects a match on a single coincidental word; min_lead_ratio 1.5 sits between the on-topic leads seen (> 2x) and the near-ties of ambiguous text (about 1x); min_vote_share 0.25 mirrors domain_routing doc_min_chunk_share 0.25 and rejects a document where 1 of 16 chunks matched. What would change them: the owner-run dry run work/TAXO-INDUCE-1107/scripts/run_induction.sh --no-llm (not-matched share now vs projected) plus a hand check of about 30 assigned titles, and the read-only SELECT in work/TAXO-MATCH-REVIEW-1108/review.md (thin_content, stored_key, with_chunks). Raise min_vote_share or min_lead_ratio if spot-checked assignments are wrong; lower them, or add registry topics, if genuine documents of a listed subject stay unmatched; add a word to generic_scholarly_terms only when it is shown to carry matches across unrelated disciplines.
